comparison.objective: Place one cup at each resident's place while ensuring cup and mat colors contrast.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual attribute matching, stable cup grasping, and upright placement.
comparison.success_condition: Each contrasting upright cup-on-mat placement earns one third; any tipped cup or same-tone pairing invalidates that placement.
comparison.reason: Tests implicit accessibility-rule inference and stable placement, with no overlap beyond generic pick-and-place.
